d:
Patna ke maner enkauntar mamle men mare gae 3 kukhyat apradhiyon ke postamartam ke dauran danapur anumandal aspatal men hinsa aur pathrav ki ghatnaen rukne ka nam nahin le rahi hain.
Taja jankari ke anusar, aspatal parisar se khadere jane ke bad aakroshit parijnon aur bhir men shamil asamajik tatvon ne dobara aspatal parisar men jabran ghusne ki koshish ki. mahaul bigarta dekh jab mauke par maujud pulis bal ne lathicharj kar bal prayog kiya, to ugr bhir ne pulis tim aur parisar men khari gariyon par tabartor eent aur pattharon se hamla bol diya.
